beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Cones of Meaning asks how careful reasoning can serve the wrong question.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its hospital example shows a waiting-time target crowding out the purpose of care.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same problem becomes urgent when AI generates persuasive explanations from competing perspectives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You learn to question what a coherent answer makes visible and leaves outside.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The hospital measures waiting time because delay is a real problem.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Once that measure becomes the target, difficult cases can be reclassified.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Consultations can also become shorter, making the reported process look more efficient.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Care that escapes the number may then appear to be wasted time.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks whether the measure still represents what the institution should protect.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Through an efficiency frame, the queue's speed becomes the main problem.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Through a patient's experience, an unfinished conversation may matter more.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book calls such selective orientations cones of meaning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their geometry is a metaphor for selection, not a literal model anatomy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book began partly with an AI extending the author's incompletely stated philosophy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That experience raises a practical question about how prompts orient apparently coherent reasoning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ask for efficiency, and a hospital proposal may foreground shorter consultations.
